heading: Agents use your saved sign-in and confirm host keys
summary: Agents fill in saved passwords and answers the way the app does, and a changed host key can be confirmed in a dialog without opening the app.
changes: With saved authentication allowed, agents use your saved passwords, saved answers, and authentication rules as the app does.
A new or changed host key opens a dialog with the previous and new fingerprints. Agents continue only after you confirm.
An old key in ~/.ssh/known_hosts no longer blocks a server whose current key you trusted in PromeFTP.
Failed agent requests list what to do next, and prompts say why they were not answered automatically.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
